name: player_try_resolve_pending_collision_probe_sweep
description: Player::TryResolvePendingCollisionProbeSweep clears pending contact queues, sweeps the first six root/modal probe pairs, drains transfer contacts into the preferred collision queue, applies collision-probe push-off velocity when collision contacts remain, and records the resolved flag.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x424ed0 validate saveState in ECX, playerState at saveState+4, ClearPendingContactQueues before sweep construction, six rootProbeWorldByIndex/modalProbeWorldByIndex segment pairs with tags 0..5, CollectPendingContactsForSegments endpointCount 12, transferQueue-to-preferredCollisionQueue drain, ApplyPendingCollisionProbeVelocity on preferred/player collision presence, and collisionProbeResolved return flag updates.
Native smoke verifies the no-contact unresolved path and a transfer-contact scene hit that is drained into preferred collision and resolves the probe.
